verdict.rationale: The release notes show OCI ships in-database AI features: a Select AI Java SDK, a Select AI Agent Framework whose agent teams run against database schemas, and OCI Generative AI model import. These suggest AI applied to the user's data inside the platform. However, the evidence never says these features produce insights or suggestions from customer data, so they are building blocks rather than a demonstrated insights experience. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or suggestions over user data, any in-console experience surfacing such insights, a description of what Select AI does with data, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
